drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you for your draft of the Share Purchase Agreement. We've made some revisions to clarify certain terms and enhance the agreement's specificity. Please find the changes highlighted below for your review.

edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall pay the Seller the Purchase Price for the Shares, which shall be defined as an amount determined at the time of sale based on a mutually agreed formula.
edits.name: Purchase Price

edits.text: 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days of the signing of this Agreement, subject to any conditions outlined in this Agreement being satisfied or waived.
edits.name: Closing

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that the financial statements, when provided, are accurate and fairly present the financial condition of the Seller as of the date hereof.
edits.name: Representations

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. The Seller indemnifies the Buyer against all undisclosed liabilities, whether known or unknown, that may arise prior to the date of Closing.
edits.name: Indemnity
